Name: Partner Overhaul
Author: Jared
Description: Fixes a cluster of vanilla Partner (companion NPC) bugs: partners can now eat stew/broth, resume cleaning finished homes, stop over-watering capped garden plots, feed Charcoal into a fireplace or fire pit, tend and warm up at a Hearth, butcher a boar piglet, smith two more blade blanks, eat Wheat Bloodbread and clean the Mud Hut's Right Room, and keep their River and Pond duty marks (and a meadowgrass patch's mark when it turns to heather) through the seasonal swaps, and no longer have their action sounds heard across the map or their dialog interrupt an in-progress spirit-summon ritual. Also removes a stray 'Defecate' button from the Tree Top scenic event, and makes a Partner's Energy level ('Looks exhausted' / 'Looks tired' / 'Looks full of energy') and Comfort level ('Looks comfortable' / 'Looks uncomfortable' / 'Looks terribly uncomfortable') visible on their card, which vanilla tracks but never shows the player. Pouring a powder such as Acorn Flour into a container that cannot take all of it is now refused instead of destroying the powder. Ships opt-in diagnostics (default off) for reporting Partner bugs, plus a few small new QoL options (config-gated), including drinking from lakes and streams and a cold following Partner asking you for warmth earlier.
